questions.question: If sec(5α - 15°) = cosec(15° - 2α), then the value of cosα + sin2α + tan(1.5α) is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

sec(5α - 15°) = cosec(15° - 2α)

**Concept used:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/13e15d912a95c91c83020164df4dce95fbb15d21ba7e6918817ece86f526ce31.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9993c810b089d3856c4ad7c7d2bcbfbf2a0d703c9a206c75cf98977204a6e4b4.png] 

**Calculation:**

sec(5α - 15°) = cosec(15° - 2α)

⇒ sec(5α - 15°) = cosec(90 - 15° + 2α)

⇒ sec(5α - 15°) = sec (75° + 2α)

⇒ 5α - 15° = 75° + 2α

⇒ 3α = 75° + 15°

⇒ α = 30°

cosα + sin2α + tan(1.5α)

⇒ cos30° + sin60° + tan45°

⇒ √3/2 + √3/2 + 1

⇒ (√3 + √3 + 2)/2

⇒ (2√3 + 2)/2

⇒ 2(√3 + 1)/2

⇒ (√3 + 1)

**∴ Required answer is (√3 + 1)**

questions.question: If 5 sin² θ - 4 cos θ - 4 = 0, 0° < θ < 90°, then the value of (cot θ + cosec θ) is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

5sin2θ – 4cosθ – 4 = 0

**Formula used:**

sin²θ = 1 – cos²θ 

P² = (H2 – B2)

Cotθ = B/P

Cosecθ = H/P

**Calculation:**

 5sin2θ – 4cosθ – 4 = 0

⇒ 5(1 – cos²θ) – 4cosθ – 4 = 0

⇒ 5 – 5cos²θ – 4cosθ – 4 = 0

⇒ 5cos²θ + 4cosθ – 1 = 0

⇒ 5cos²θ + 5cosθ – cosθ – 1 = 0

⇒ 5cosθ(cosθ + 1) – 1(cosθ + 1) = 0

⇒ (5cosθ – 1) (cosθ + 1) = 0

⇒ cosθ = 1/5 or -1

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/514fe1bc74ce877e863a8724eef8d6f0b2a2bbd64d9cbd06a3eb8cdfb95f128b.png] 

By Pythagoras theorem

⇒ P² = (H2 – B2)

⇒ P² = (52 – 12)

⇒ P² =(25 – 1)

⇒ P² = 24

⇒ P = 2√6

Now,

Cotθ = B/P = 1/2√6

Cosecθ = H/P = 5/2√6

(cot θ + cosec θ) = (1/2√6 + 5/2√6)

⇒ (6/2√6) 

⇒ (3/√6)

Multiplying the conjugate of √6 to numerator and denominator, we get

⇒ (3/√6 × √6/√6)

⇒ ( 3√6/6)

⇒ √6/2

**∴ The required value is √6/2**

questions.question: In ΔPQR, ∠Q = 90°. If tan R = (1)/(3) then what is the value of (secP(cosR+sinP))/(cosecR(sinR-cosecP))?
questions.solution:

tan R = 1/3

**Formula used:**

H² = B2 + P2 

tan θ = P/B

sec θ = H/B

cos θ = B/H

cosec θ = H/P

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ffae2fa1f26890230542153e0efa8677d709fc3816524b051ea0e51974af399a.png] 

By Pythagoras theorem

⇒ H² = B2 + P2 

⇒ H² = (32 + 12) 

⇒ H² = (9 + 1) 

⇒ H² = 10

⇒ H = √10

Now,

sec P = √10/1

cos R = 3/√10

sin P = 3/√10

cosec R = √10/1

sin R = 1/√10

cosec P = √10/3

Now,

** (secP(cosR+sinP))/(cosecR(sinR-cosecP)) = frac{sqrt{10}((3)/(sqrt{10)}+(3)/(sqrt{10)})}{sqrt{10}((1)/(sqrt{10)}-frac{sqrt{10}}{3})}**

**⇒ (frac{6)/(sqrt{10)}}{((3-10))/(3sqrt{10)}}=frac{6times 3sqrt{10}}{sqrt{10} times -7}=(-18)/(7)**

∴ The required value is -18/7

questions.question: The value of (3cos²27^circ-5 + 3cos²63^circ )/(tan²32^circ + 4 - cosec² 58^circ) + sin35°cos55° + cos35°sin55° is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

(3cos²27^circ-5 + 3cos²63^circ )/(tan²32^circ + 4 - cosec² 58^circ)

**Formula used:**

sin²θ + cos²θ = 1

tan²θ = sec²θ - 1 'or' sec2θ - tan²θ = 1

**Calculation:**

According to the question

(3cos²27^circ-5 + 3cos²63^circ )/(tan²32^circ + 4 - cosec² 58^circ) + sin35° cos55° + cos35° sin55°

⇒ (3cos²27° – 5 + 3sin²27°)/(tan²32° + 4 – sec²32°) + sin35°sin35° + cos35°cos35° 

⇒ 3(sin²27° + cos²27°) – 5/4 – (sec232° - tan232 ) + (sin²35° + cos²35°)

⇒ [3(1) – 5]/(4 – 1) + 1

⇒ (3 – 5)3 + 1

⇒ -2/3 + 1

⇒ (-2 + 3)/3

⇒ 1/3

**∴ The required value is (1)/(3)**

questions.question: sec 2A (cos⁸ A - sin⁸ A)/(1 + cos² 2A) is equals to which of the following.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

sec 2A (cos⁸ A - sin⁸ A)/(1 + cos² 2A)

**Concept Used:**

(a² - b²) = (a + b)(a - b)

cos 2A = cos² A - sin² A

**Calculation**:

sec 2A (cos⁸ A - sin⁸ A)/(1 + cos² 2A)

⇒ (cos⁸ A - sin⁸ A)/(1 + cos² 2A) cos 2A

⇒ (cos⁸ A - sin⁸ A)/(1 + (cos² A - sin² A)²) cos 2A

⇒ (cos⁴ A + sin⁴ A)(cos⁴ A - sin⁴ A)/(1 + cos⁴ A + sin⁴ A - 2sin²A cos² A)( cos² A - sin² A)

⇒ (cos⁴ A + sin⁴ A)(cos² A - sin² A)(cos² A + sin² A)/(1 + cos⁴ A + sin⁴ A - 2sin²A cos² A)( cos² A - sin² A)

⇒ (cos⁴ A + sin⁴ A)(cos² A + sin² A)/(1 + cos⁴ A + sin⁴ A - 2sin²A cos² A)

⇒ (1 - 2cos² A sin² A)/{1 + (cos² A + sin² A)² - 2sin²A cos² A - 2sin²A cos² A}

⇒ (1 - 2cos2 A sin2 A)/{1 + 1 - 4sin2A cos2 A }

⇒ (1 - 2cos2 A sin2 A)/2{1 - 2sin2A cos2 A }

⇒ 1/2

**∴ The value will be 1/2.**

questions.question: ((1+cos theta)(cosec theta-cot theta)sec theta)/(sin theta(1-sintheta)(sec theta+tan theta))=?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

((1+cos θ)(cosec θ-cot θ)sec θ)/(sin θ(1-sinθ)(sec θ+tan θ))=?

**Formula used:**

cosecθ = 1/sinθ 

secθ = 1/cosθ 

cotθ = cosθ/sinθ

tanθ = sinθ/cosθ 

1 – cos²θ = sin²θ 

1 – sin²θ = cos²θ 

**Calculation:**

((1+cos θ)(cosec θ-cot θ)sec θ)/(sin θ(1-sinθ)(sec θ+tan θ))=?

⇒ [(1 + cosθ)(1/sinθ – cosθ/sinθ) 1/cosθ]/[sinθ(1 – sinθ)(1/cosθ + sinθ/cosθ)]

⇒ [(1 + cosθ)(1 – cosθ/sinθ) 1/cosθ]/[sinθ(1 – sinθ)(1 + sinθ/cosθ)]

⇒ [(1 – cos²θ)/sinθ × 1/cosθ]/[sinθ (1 – sin²θ)/cosθ]

⇒ (sin²θ/sinθ × 1/cosθ)/(sinθ × cos²θ/cosθ)

⇒ (sinθ/cosθ)/(sinθ × cosθ)

⇒ 1/cos²θ 

⇒ sec²θ 

**∴ The value of ? is sec²θ**

questions.question: If 16 sec² θ – 40 sec θ + 25 = 0 and θ is an acute angle, then what will be the value of tan θ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

16 sec² θ – 40 sec θ + 25 = 0

**Calculation:**

⇒ 16 sec² θ – 40 sec θ + 25 = 0

⇒ 16 sec² θ – 2 × 4 × 5 sec θ + 25 = 0

⇒ (4secθ - 5)² = 0

⇒ 4secθ = 5

⇒ secθ = 5/4

Then,

⇒ 1 + tan²θ = sec²θ

⇒ tan² θ = 25/16 - 1 = 9/16

**∴ tanθ = 3/4**
